title: Community Pool Back Open Just in Time for Summer!
description:
The Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Pool is back open! 🏊 

After an 18-month closure for its first major renovation since opening over 50 years ago, the pool has opened just in time for community members to cool off, swim, relax and have fun this summer.

Learn more about the work that was done and activities at this and all of the City's pools this summer: insidesandiego.org/community-pool-back-open-just-time-summer-following-major-renovationsen!
